race.comment: GALWAY GAL (8) made the best debut in the race when second at this track over 1400m, beaten just under a length after settling back and having some difficulty getting clear near the 100m. The extra ground is new, but the way she finished off on soft ground suggests she'll be very hard to beat. URBAN CREED (3) has placed three times from four starts and was third at Ballarat on resumption after being bumped early and racing wide, which keeps him firmly in the mix with added fitness. RUSSIAN FIREBIRD (2) resumes after trialling at Seymour last week and his narrow Cranbourne fourth before the Bendigo failure gives him a realistic minor hope if ready. KERMALINA (11) has shown glimpses, next best.
